title: R3.0E Recommendation Experiment & Outcome Loop — schema
note: Defines the legal universe of checkpoints, capabilities, transitions, and authorized-path rules for the R3.0E phase of the R3.0 Integrated Delivery Train. E0 establishes the schema; E1..E5 are NOT yet authorized — they describe future intent so the validator can refuse premature activation. R3.0E depends on R3.0D completing all the way to D5_ACTIVATION before any non-bootstrap E checkpoint may advance — that cross-phase rule is enforced by scripts/check-r3-0-train.js, not by this single-phase schema. Per SKYLINE D12/E1 ruling: Experiment / Outcome / Hypothesis / follow-up linkage live in SEPARATE versioned IndexedDB namespaces and MUST NOT extend the frozen R3.0B case-record schema.

authorizedPathRules.note: R3.0E production authorization is by exact repo-relative path only. No wildcards/regex/globs. Tests and docs are never authorized as production paths. R3.0E MUST NOT modify the frozen R3.0B case-record schema; experiment/outcome/hypothesis/follow-up data live in separate IndexedDB namespaces.
